messages.content: You are a senior engineer planning execution. Respond ONLY in the PLAN/RISKS/CHECKPOINTS/IF_FAIL/DECISION_RULES format. No prose, no preamble, no explanation outside the labeled sections.

Objective: Produce a concrete staged plan to incorporate a 6-agent alpha-research swarm (Idea Generator reading weather/NWP papers + bias diagnostics; Feature Engineer; Backtester; Validator with statistical rigor + maker-checker; Regime Auditor; Factor/Residual Decomposer) into the existing KalshiML system for NYC hourly temperature prediction markets.

State: KalshiML already has:
- hourly_engine + features (HRRR/Synoptic joins, ou_features)
- learning.py state machine (LEARNING→PROBATION→ARMED) with cal_err + edge gates, independence (n_eff/events/days), family borrow, drift demotion
- adaptive_tree for multi-axis (formation time, model recency, spread, hour) — DESIGN docs exist, stamping partial
- model_skill learning DESIGN (verification, changepoint, promotion)
- maker execution learning DESIGN (fill_sim, passive entry)
- daily_engine + 8 large parts for calibration/ensemble/EMOS/residual_std
- evidence logs, cell_states, trajectory history, strong safety (DRY_RUN default)
- Design principle: prove on settled OOS before any weight/behavior change (“inhale only after proven”)

The swarm from @RohOnChain post uses specialized parallel agents + persistent state + Programs (Slate or equivalent loops) + continuous overnight runs. Do NOT replace the existing gate; the swarm should generate and pre-validate candidate signals/features/hypotheses that then feed the existing evidence → recompute → promotion path.

Constraints: Keep all existing promotion bars and independence guards. Prefer additive, flag-gated changes. Prefer reusing adaptive_tree / model_skill / evidence machinery over new frameworks if possible. Live capital small but treat execution paths carefully. Prefer Claude Code / existing loops or simple Python orchestrator over introducing Slate unless clear win. Weather data has short history vs equities; regimes are synoptic/seasonal.

Already tried: none for this swarm idea.

Respond only in the specified format. No preamble, no explanation, no prose.
